name: jungle_depths_floors_b
prompt:
16-bit pixel art FLOOR TILE SHEET for a top-down bomberman-style pale-green jungle stage. Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows of equal 320x320 cells on one flat plain cream background (#F7F1E3). No grid lines, no frames, no labels, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Each cell contains ONE seamless 40x40 floor tile that fills the entire cell edge to edge, viewed straight from above, perfectly tileable on all four edges, low contrast, fine subtle texture, no objects, no props, no shadow, no border, no lighting gradient. All nine tiles share the same pale-green palette and soft daylight: pale sage green, mint, young leaf green, pale jade stone, cream highlights, low-saturation warm earth; crisp chunky pixels, 1px darker grout/crack details only where described, no anti-aliasing, no blur.

TOP ROW: (1) calm pale grass with fine short blades, very low contrast, almost flat; (2) the same pale grass with a few tiny white and yellow wildflowers scattered sparsely; (3) pale grass with soft moss patches and tiny clover, still low contrast.

MIDDLE ROW: (4) pale jade-green stone pavers with thin 1px darker grout lines, calm and even; (5) the same stone pavers with light moss creeping through a few cracks; (6) pale green stone pavers with a few scattered fallen leaves and tiny grass tufts.

BOTTOM ROW: (7) packed pale earth with fine grain and a few small pebbles, low contrast; (8) the same earth with scattered brown and yellow fallen leaves; (9) clear shallow water, pale blue-green, soft small ripple highlights, seamless.

RULES: all tiles must read as the same ground family, no large motifs, no strong patterns, no dark holes, no shadows, no objects; each tile alone is a flat seamless texture.
